name: QuasarCheuk Pink Surge Protector Power Strip
shortDescription: A pink 14-in-1 surge protector power strip for cute desk setups, with AC outlets, USB-A and USB-C charging ports, and a 5 ft flat cord.
longDescription: This QuasarCheuk pink surge protector power strip is a practical desk accessory for kawaii workstations, gaming corners, dorm rooms, and vanity setups that need more charging space without ruining the color theme. The product photos show a 14-in-1 layout with 8 AC outlets, 3 USB-A ports, 3 USB-C ports, an on/off switch, surge protection, a 45-degree flat plug, and a 5 ft flat wire. It is compact enough for desks and travel-style setups, while the soft pink color makes it easier to blend with cute keyboards, monitor stands, lamps, and room decor. Before publishing or buying, confirm the current safety certifications, wattage limits, USB charging output, and plug type on the Amazon listing.
pros: Pink color fits kawaii desk, dorm, and vanity setups
14-in-1 layout gives room for AC plugs plus USB-A and USB-C devices
Flat plug is useful behind furniture or tight wall outlets
On/off switch makes it easy to shut down the whole strip
Compact shape is easier to place on a desk than a long traditional strip
cons: Only 5 ft cord length, so placement may be limited in larger rooms
USB charging speed should be checked against your device needs
Bulky adapters may block nearby outlets depending on plug shape
Safety certifications and power limits should be verified before publishing
bestFor: Kawaii desk setups, dorm rooms, vanity tables, small workstations, gaming corners, and anyone who wants a cute pink power strip with USB charging ports.
